description: This file contains configuration and setup code for an engine management system tailored for Honda Accord and Prelude models. It includes functions to set engine parameters such as sensor types, fuel injection, ignition modes, and hardware channel mappings, along with specific configurations for different vehicle models and trigger types.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfigurationCommon(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for Honda Accord based on the engine type and hardware setup.

methods.description: Sets up the engine configuration for a Honda Accord with three-wire trigger setup, utilizing the common configuration function.

methods.description: Sets up the engine configuration for a Honda Accord with DIP switch trigger type, utilizing the common configuration function.
